title: notific.me Question Set
description: Question set sent by ask(). The reply comes back as a single signed package.

context.description: Explanation for the human (why they are being asked).

level.description: Minimum verification level. The workspace may require more.

severity.description: How urgent the decision is. critical: the person's app may take the full screen with an alarm until they decide (their choice in the app).

quorum.description: Shorthand for decision { rule: "quorum", required } among the recipients in to.

on_timeout.description: Answers applied when nobody answers in time, by question id.

escalate.description: Escalation chain: if the question is still open after each step's time, the step's recipients also receive it and may decide (the earlier recipients still can).

oneOf.description: Shorthand for { "to": [this], "after": half of the timeout }.

callback_url.description: Webhook que recebe a resposta assinada.

require_signature.description: Ask the person to sign the answer with their electronic signature (typed in a cursive style or drawn) and initials, on top of the verification level. The signed reply carries it in e_signature. Pro plans and above.

decision.description: Who may decide and which rule closes the question. Without it, anyone in to decides and the first answer closes the question.

by.description: Who may decide: #group, #group>=authority_level (e.g. #finance>=manager), @handle or a member's e-mail. They also receive the card. Default: everyone in to.

rule.description: any: the first answer closes it. quorum: required approvals. majority: more than half of the eligible people. unanimous: every eligible person. each_group: one approval from each entry of by (four-eyes).

veto.description: true: a single rejection closes the question as rejected. false: rejections only count; it closes as rejected once approval can no longer be reached.

question.description: The question whose answer is the vote (yesno, or single with approve_options). Default: the first question.

approve_options.description: With a single-choice vote question: the options that count as approval (the others count as rejection).

requested_by.description: The member who made the request (@handle or e-mail). They never approve their own request (segregation of duties).

after.description: Time since the question was sent.

to.description: Who receives it and may decide from then on (#group, #group>=level, @handle or e-mail).

allow_other.description: Allows free text besides the options.
